title: 2021年6月四级真题 第1套 阅读2
paperTitle: 2021年6月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
passage:
P1 Being an information technology, or IT, worker is not a job I envy. They are the ones who, right in the middle of a critical meeting, are expected to instantly fix the projector that's no longer working. They have to tolerate the bad tempers of colleagues frustrated at the number of times they've had to call the help desk for the same issue. They are also the ones who know there are systems that are more powerful, reliable and faster, but their employer simply will not put up the funds to buy them.

P2 According to a recent survey, employees who have a job reliant on IT support consider IT a major source of job dissatisfaction. Through no fault of their own, they can suddenly find their productivity deteriorating or quality control non-existent. And there's little they can do about it.

P3 The experience of using IT penetrates almost the entire work field. It has become a crucial part of employees' overall work experience. When IT is operating as it should, employee self-confidence swells. Their job satisfaction, too, can surge when well-functioning machines relieve them of dull tasks or repetitive processes. But if there's one thing that triggers widespread employee frustration, it's an IT transformation project gone wrong, where swollen expectations have been popped and a long list of promised efficiencies has been reversed. This occurs when business leaders implement IT initiatives with little consideration of how those changes will impact the end user.

P4 Which is why managers should appreciate just how influential the IT user experience is to their employees, and exert substantial effort in ensuring their IT team eliminates programming errors and application crashes. Adequate and timely IT support should also be available to enable users to cope with technological issues at work. More importantly, IT practitioners need to understand what employees experience mentally when they use IT.

P5 Therefore, businesses need to set up their IT infrastructure so that it is designed to fit in with their employees' work, rather than adjust their work to fit in with the company's IT limitations.

questions.q: What does the author say about working in IT?
options: It is envied by many.
It does not appeal to him.
It is financially rewarding.
It does not match his abilities.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does the author say about working in IT? 用 what 引导，问作者对某一具体对象 的明确表态，属于带主观色彩的细节题，而不是 infer/imply。

【拆句】题干是简单疑问句，主干为 What does the author say about working in IT?，about 引 出话题，结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。

【定位】Being an information technology, or IT, worker is not a job I envy. 成为一名信息技术（即 IT）工作者，不是一份我会羡慕的工作。 51. What does the author say about working in IT? A) It is envied by many. B) It does not appeal to him. C) It is financially rewarding. D) It does not match his abilities.

【选项】A) 与原文相反 It is envied by many. 把作者 not a job I envy 的态度改成"很多人羡慕"，方向完全相 反，且原文也没说"很多人羡慕"。 B) ✓ 正确 not a job I envy ↔does not appeal to him 预判"作者不羡慕 IT 工作"与 It does not appeal to him. 同义；其余选项与作者表态相 反或与文意无关。 C) 无中生有 It is financially rewarding. 称 IT 工作"经济回报丰厚"，但全文从未谈及薪资或金钱收 益，纯属编造。 D) 偷换概念 It does not match his abilities. 说 IT 工作"与他的能力不匹配"，原文只说作者不羡 慕、并描述 IT 工作辛苦，从未涉及作者本人的能力是否够格。 最近一项针对工作依赖IT支持的员工的调查有何发现? A) IT有助于提高生产力。 B) IT有助于改善质量控制。 C) 许多员工对IT深感沮丧。 D) 大多数员工在工作中严重依赖IT。

questions.q: What is the finding of a recent survey on employees who have a job reliant on IT support?
options: IT helps boost productivity.
IT helps improve quality control.
Many employees are deeply frustrated by IT.
Most employees rely heavily on IT in their work.
questions.explain:
【判型】What is the finding of a recent survey 直接问一项调查的发现，是对原文具体信息的复 述，属于细节题。

【拆句】主干 What is the finding of a recent survey on employees，on 引出调查对象、who 从 句进一步限定。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。

【定位】According to a recent survey, employees who have a job reliant on IT support consider IT a major source of job dissatisfaction. 根据一项最新调查，工作依赖 IT 支持的员工把 IT 视为工作不满的主要来源。 52. What is the finding of a recent survey on employees who have a job reliant on IT support? A) IT helps boost productivity. B) IT helps improve quality control. C) Many employees are deeply frustrated by IT. D) Most employees rely heavily on IT in their work.

【选项】A) 与原文相反 IT helps boost productivity. 说 IT 提升生产力，与原文 their productivity deteriorating（生产力下降）完全相反。 B) 与原文相反 IT helps improve quality control. 说 IT 改善质量控制，但原文是 quality control non-existent，质控"不复存在"，方向反转。 C) ✓ 正确 consider IT a major source of job dissatisfaction ↔ Many employees are deeply frustrated by IT 预判"员工对 IT 极度不满"与 Many employees are deeply frustrated by IT. 完全吻 合；其他三项要么把 IT 说成正面作用，要么扯到使用频率，均偏离结论。 D) 答非所问 Most employees rely heavily on IT in their work. 说"大多数员工严重依赖 IT"，但题 干问的是调查的 finding，而原文 finding 是"员工不满"，不是"员工依赖"；"依赖"只是 调查对象的限定条件，不是调查结论。 据说当IT正常运行时会发生什么? A) 员工的工作效率会大幅提升。 B) 员工变得更加依赖机器。 C) 不再有任何枯燥或重复性的任务。 D) 员工对自己的工作变得更有信心。

questions.q: What is said to happen when IT is functioning properly?
options: There is a big boost in employees' work efficiency.
Employees become more dependent on machines.
There are no longer any boring or repetitive tasks.
Employees become more confident in their work.
questions.explain:
【判型】What is said to happen when IT is functioning properly? 问在某条件下会发生什么具体 结果，是原文已有陈述的复述题，属细节题。

【拆句】题干主干 What is said to happen，when 从句修饰 happen，is said 是被动语态，弱化 作者主观色彩，照常按客观细节处理。

【定位】When IT is operating as it should, employee self-confidence swells. 当 IT 像它本应那样运转时，员工的自信心便会膨胀。 53. What is said to happen when IT is functioning properly? A) There is a big boost in employees' work efficiency. B) Employees become more dependent on machines. C) There are no longer any boring or repetitive tasks. D) Employees become more confident in their work.

【选项】A) 过度推断 There is a big boost in employees' work efficiency. 把答案换成"工作效率大幅提 升"，原文只说自信和工作满意度上升，并未在 IT 正常运转时给出"效率大幅提升"的结 论；"a big boost"也属于原文未表达的程度夸大。 B) 偷换概念 Employees become more dependent on machines. 说员工"更依赖机器"，原文谈的 是 IT 正常时员工"自信增强"，未涉及依赖加深；"依赖加深"通常是负面评价，与本段 IT 正常时的正向描述也不符。 C) 过度推断 原文 well-functioning machines relieve them of dull tasks or repetitive processes 说机器"减轻"枯燥重复任务，There are no longer any boring or repetitive tasks. 却 说"不再有任何"重复任务，把"缓解"夸大为"彻底消除"。 D) ✓ 正确 employee self-confidence swells ↔Employees become more confident in their work 预判"员工自信增强"与 Employees become more confident in their work. 几乎逐字 同义；其余选项不是过度推断就是与原文相反。 企业领导者在实施新的IT举措之前应该做什么? A) 考虑客户的各种期望。 B) 列出承诺要实现的各项效率提升。 C) 评估培训员工的高昂成本。 D) 考虑对员工可能产生的影响。

questions.q: What should business leaders do before implementing new IT initiatives?
options: Consider the various expectations of their customers.
Draw up a list of the efficiencies to be promised.
Assess the swollen cost of training the employees.
Think about the possible effects on their employees.
questions.explain:
【判型】What should business leaders do before implementing new IT initiatives? 问"应当做 什么"，对应原文里直接给出建议/批评的句子，是细节题。

【拆句】主干 What should business leaders do，before 引导时间状语 before implementing new IT initiatives，implementing 是动名词作介词宾语。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。

【定位】Which is why managers should appreciate just how influential the IT user experience is to their employees, and exert substantial effort in ensuring their IT team eliminates programming errors and application crashes. 正因如此，管理者应当意识到 IT 用户体验对员工有多大影响，并下大力气确保 IT 团队消除 程序错误与应用崩溃。 54. What should business leaders do before implementing new IT initiatives? A) Consider the various expectations of their customers. B) Draw up a list of the efficiencies to be promised. C) Assess the swollen cost of training the employees. D) Think about the possible effects on their employees.

【选项】A) 张冠李戴 Consider the various expectations of their customers. 把考虑对象从员工换成"客 户"，但全文从未谈及 customers，关注点始终是 employees/end user。 B) 与原文相反 Draw up a list of the efficiencies to be promised. 把"承诺的效率"列成清单，原文恰 恰批评 a long list of promised efficiencies has been reversed，即"承诺过的效率被 打回原形"，是失败之处而非应做之事。 C) 无中生有 Assess the swollen cost of training the employees. 借用 swollen expectations have been popped 中的 swollen 拼出"激增的培训成本"，但原文 swollen 形容的是 expectations（被吹胀的预期），从未提培训成本。 D) ✓ 正确 with little consideration of how those changes will impact the end user ↔ Think about the possible effects on their employees managers should appreciate just how influential the IT user experience is to their employees ↔ Think about the possible effects on their employees 预判"先考虑对员工的影响"和 Think about the possible effects on their employees. 高度吻合；A/B/C 要么换错对象，要么偏离核心动作。 企业如何帮助改善员工使用IT的体验? A) 通过设计适合他们需求的系统。 B) 通过确保他们的心理健康状况良好。 C) 通过调整他们的工作以适应IT系统。 D) 通过为他们提供定期的在职培训。

questions.q: How can a business help improve its employees' experience in using IT?
options: By designing systems that suit their needs.
By ensuring that their mental health is sound.
By adjusting their work to suit the IT system.
By offering them regular in-service training.
questions.explain:
【判型】How can a business help improve its employees' experience in using IT? 问公司具体 如何改善，对应原文给出的具体做法句，属细节题。

【拆句】主干 How can a business help improve its employees' experience，in using IT 是后置 介词短语修饰 experience。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。

【定位】Therefore, businesses need to set up their IT infrastructure so that it is designed to fit in with their employees' work, rather than adjust their work to fit in with the company's IT limitations. 因此，企业需要这样搭建其 IT 基础设施：使其设计去适配员工的工作，而不是让员工调整 工作去迁就公司的 IT 局限。 55. How can a business help improve its employees' experience in using IT? A) By designing systems that suit their needs. B) By ensuring that their mental health is sound. C) By adjusting their work to suit the IT system. D) By offering them regular in-service training.

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 set up their IT infrastructure so that it is designed to fit in with their employees' work ↔ By designing systems that suit their needs 预判"IT 去适配员工"严丝合缝对应 By designing systems that suit their needs.； B/C/D 要么扯心理健康、要么取了 rather than 后的反向做法、要么属于无中生有的 培训。 B) 偷换概念 By ensuring that their mental health is sound. 借用 what employees experience mentally when they use IT 里的 mentally 拼出"确保心理健康"，但原文是"理解员工使 用 IT 时的心理体验"，不是"维护员工心理健康"，且这一点也不是末段给出的总对策。 C) 与原文相反 By adjusting their work to suit the IT system. 把 rather than 后的反面做法 adjust their work to fit in with the company's IT limitations 当成对策，方向完全反转。 D) 无中生有 By offering them regular in-service training. 提到"定期在职培训"，全文从未谈及培 训这件事，纯属新概念。
